description: Fires only right after the opponent drops a stone into the centre column (3) on top of at least one of MY stones there (never when it lands on the bottom row or on only their own stones), once the game is past roughly 12-14 stones. Stronger with 2-3 of my stones under it and more stones elsewhere; stones in column 4 (and 2, 5) weaken it.
effect: None measurable: forcing it to max or zero changes move probabilities by at most 0.02 on three positions.
notes: Layer-0 unit, behaves like a bag-of-tokens readout: last token = col 3 plus my earlier col-3 tokens, plus a ply term saturating ~14 stones, modulated by column/owner of other stones (context-dependent). Dev: v1 simple rule F1 0.60 (recall 0.98); best v4 weighted score F1 0.702 (P 0.62, R 0.80), AUROC 0.89, sim share 0.61. Minimal pairs agree on the core (col3, my stone below, late ply); the near-threshold modulation by other columns is only roughly captured, so confidence medium. All 5 synthesis positions beat dev max (best 3.18). Synthesis revised after orchestrator audit: 4 of the original 5 sequences completed a four (move 7 vertical in col 0, or move 22 anti-diagonal), so they were replaced by four-free sequences (checked move by move); kept the one valid original; all 5 still beat dev max (2.82-2.92).
